name: Erdőbénye (Hungary)
description: Cream field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Erdőbénye (a crowned blue shield with a white figure and a bunch of grapes, with blue, red and yellow mantling) above the name ERDŐBÉNYE in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Erdőbénye arms with crown and mantling
